Blackmores Joint Mobility Plus supports joint health in active individuals and muscle and bone health. UC-II®, which contains type II collagen, helps reduce joint discomfort and helps improve joint mobility in mild osteoarthritis, and it also contains Vitamin D to helps the absorption of dietary calcium which supports bone health and Vitamin C to help support healthy joint cartilage growth.
